text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout v2026.03.22-galileo. Feature flag 'model-route-v3' canary: 2.5% global (internal-canary), pinned to model=llama-2-13b-q4a. Monitors: p50/p95/p99, 5xx, 429, kv_hit_rate. Change window 03:00-06:00 UTC.
sara: Copy. I'll watch p95/p99. If p99 > 600ms or 5xx > 0.3% we hold.
nate: Note: put the pin & rollback steps in the release notes. KV warmup job recommended before next jump.
ops-bot: Canary deployed: global=2.5%, regions=default. Metrics t+60s: p95=210ms, p99=410ms, 5xx=0.02%, kv_hit_rate=89%.
kai: Seeing a small 429 bump in eu-central at t+90s, likely queue saturation on that shard.
sara: Reduce eu-central to 0% to isolate. Command:
```
/deploybot ff set model-route-v3 --region eu-central --percent 0 --reason "429 spike"
```
deploy-bot: Executed. eu-central=0% (effective global ~2.1%). Pin remains.
nate: Also toggle conserve batching for canary to reduce burst memory.
ops-bot: Batch profile updated: canary -> conserve-lite. Post-change metrics: mem down, 429s falling.
sara: Lower global to 1% while we watch the shard behavior. If stable for 20m, ramp plan: 1% -> 5% -> 12% with 10m holdpoints and KV prime before each.
release-manager: Adding to release notes: "Canary pinned to llama-2-13b-q4a; eu-central held due to 429s; batch-profile conserve-lite applied; rollback: set global 0%, unpin, route to stable v2026.02.14."
kai: After 12m observation, metrics steady. Scheduling KV prime job in eu regions before next increase.
sara: OK I'll approve manual jump to 5% after KV prime completes and 10m stable. Leaving watch for next 30m. :eyes:
